headline: A new wallet moved most of its first credit out within 30 minutes.

clause_quotes.quote: A first inbound credit followed by cash-out within 30 minutes, moving 80 percent or more of that credit, may indicate a first-credit drain.

why_not_other_actions: A draft freeze merits review because the first-credit timing and amount are corroborated. [T01_first_credit_drain]
open_questions: What additional customer or settlement evidence would resolve the open concern?
known_facts: Use tables and short findings. Do not propose goodwill.
